name: AvatarMaker
author: TheMoneyGlitch
summary: Designs matching square avatars and profile packs for your Grok Bots after helping you choose a shared visual style.
starterPrompt: Help me pick a consistent visual style for these Grok Bots. Show one sample avatar first, then prepare matching square portraits and profile text for the rest.
usageNote: Review the sample before generating a full set. Use reference images you have permission to use, and apply the finished profile packs yourself.
